title: A Raid
text: “Elephant! Time for singing practice, I say!”
“Ah, right.”
“You must work together with Filolial-sama to wake that lazy sleeper over there with song, indeed!”
“Ahh… I don’t think that’ll work. She was sleeping yesterday too, so I’m pretty sure she’s using it as a lullaby.”
Grr… the songs from Elephant and Filolial-sama certainly have no unpleasant elements to them, I say.
“Sure, she’s lazy, but you can tell she does her work when it counts… her nose for money seems to rival Larsa’s.”
Panda may be a miser, but her spending includes donations, so Panda is nothing like Lazy Pig, I say!

“She actually suggested to Hero-sama that we buy a slave, raise it up a bit, and sell it for a high price. When Hero-sama refused, she backed off with a sigh, muttering something about how you can’t run this kind of business if you get attached… there was no arguing with that.”

Grr… even Elephant couldn’t talk back to that one. Indeed, even I couldn’t bring myself to raise Filolial-sama just to sell them off. Slaves might be easy enough to sell, but Father is far too kind for that. Damn it all, I say. Fine then—you shall be in charge of nothing but the dark underbelly of this circus, indeed! In the first place, what business does a mere peddler have getting involved in this at all? Well, no matter, I say… when the time comes to dispose of the Crimson Swine, I shall deliberately let it sense the danger and simply fade it out. Thus did I lay my plans for the day that must surely come.
“Boo-boo!”
And so, having been recruited as a housewarming gift of sorts, Keel was sent off to Big Sister’s place, I say.
“Keel-kun!”
“It’s Keel-kun!”
“Boo-boo-boo!”

We had a reunion with Big Sister and the others at the Zeltoble treatment facility, indeed. Her symptoms had apparently improved quite a bit, and there was talk of setting up a separate base for them to live in. Everyone was overjoyed at the reunion.
“Thank you so much for bringing Keel-kun along as well.”
Big Sister and Big Sister’s friend both bowed their heads together to Father and me, I say.
“Don’t worry about it. You two have been through a terrible ordeal.”
“You keep saying that, but… please, let us help with something.”
“Hmm…”

Father seemed to be gently deflecting Big Sister and the others’ requests each time, insisting they rest instead, I say. Incidentally, Big Sister’s friend had also recovered quite a bit and was now able to walk.
“This concerns our own village. I don’t think it’s right for us to just be helped.”
“I understand how you feel, but…”
“Boo-boo!”
Keel thrust a fist forward and said something, indeed.
“Ahh… right. We run a circus. Did you hear about that from Elena-san, perhaps?”
“Boo!”
Keel nodded firmly, as if to confirm it.
“Hmm.”
Though still small in scale, the acts were reasonably well-rounded, I say. Father seemed to be considering what Big Sister and the others might be able to contribute.
“I’ll think about it seriously. What you two need to do right now is rest properly. Let’s see… Sadeena-san, was it? Let’s decide once you’ve met with her.”

Father said he fully appreciated their enthusiasm, but ultimately chose to wait for their recovery, indeed. Apparently it wasn’t too late to decide after joining up and talking things over with Big Sister’s Older Sister.
“…Understood.”
“Okay!”
“Boo!”

Big Sister and the others obediently backed down, I say. Or so it seemed on the surface—though as it later turned out, they had secretly begun practicing circus tricks behind the scenes, indeed. Things like juggling beanbags and practicing catching thrown objects, apparently.
“Now then… we’re off, everyone.”

That was Father speaking, I say. This time, he planned to head toward the Zeltoble area with the mixed-breed Lizardman, the Rabbit Man, and Wolf in tow for some practical combat training. If it were simply a matter of leveling up, I or Filolial-sama could easily handle that, but Father apparently wanted these three slaves to get a bit of practice acting as a party. Incidentally, to slip past prying eyes, everyone would don robes and blend into the crowd, and I’d instantly use Portal at some street corner to shake off any pursuers, I say. Quite effective, indeed. Beyond that, the circus was subject to fairly frequent inspections from the town guard. The meddling of the Three Heroes Church, I say. Those matters were handled by the monster merchant’s subordinates and Lazy Pig, who saw them off without incident each time. Melromarc doesn’t prohibit the buying and selling of slaves, after all, so that couldn’t be used as grounds for a raid. Well, there are the occasional tip-offs claiming we’re dealing in human slaves here, prompting a thorough search—but by then, the evidence has already been disposed of.
“Are you really going to be all right?”
“Are you sure-sure?”
Elephant and Kou called out with worried voices, I say.
“No need to be so overprotective. If everyone’s constantly being protected or guarded by strong people, they’ll never get real combat experience.”

Since they were sneaking off toward Zeltoble, there was absolutely no chance of Three Heroes Church assassins showing up, I say. It seemed Father had assembled this party according to some plan of his own. If the me from before I awakened to true love had seen the current lineup Father had put together, I imagine he’d have thought it a rather unsavory, grubby bunch—but in his own way, Father was clearly trying to make good use of his first slaves. The slaves themselves seemed to be growing more accustomed to and fond of Father as well.
“With the calamity of the Waves drawing near one way or another, everyone needs to learn how to defend themselves.”

Father still hadn’t decided whether he’d have the slaves participate in the Waves, and hadn’t discussed the details with them yet, apparently. Still, he wanted to gauge just how well this group could fight, or something along those lines.
“If that’s the case, then I suppose it’s fine, but…”

Elephant, acting as combat advisor, was teaching the mixed-breed Lizardman and Rabbit Man, I say. She’d issued each of them a standard-issue axe and a one-handed dagger to train with. The mixed-breed Lizardman apparently had some prior experience, as his stance looked quite proper, while the Rabbit Man had only handled a dagger before, more or less. Father had, in his usual fashion, stashed all sorts of supplies inside his shield, and had Kuro-chan and the other Filolial-sama give them a bit of a boost, so their defenses had risen considerably. At the very least, they likely wouldn’t even flinch from an assassin’s attack.
“Bow!”

Wolf barked out something about her own job, but apparently Father had applied a trait enhancement to her and lowered her Level in the process, I say. Something about adjusting her Level to match the mixed-breed Lizardman and Rabbit Man.
“Do take care, please.”
The Siltvelt envoy also seemed worried, but since Father’s orders were absolute, she resigned herself to seeing them off, I say.
“So Kou-san will be coming along as well, then?”
“Yep. Going to go play at Rifana and the others’ place—”

Kou was indeed set to go play with Big Sister and the others, I say. With Elephant and Big Sister’s group paired up, Kou needed to learn properly from them, after all. So that Kou would never have to feel afraid, ever—that’s what he needed to learn, indeed.
“All right then, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Understood.”
“Departure time!”
And with that, we flew off to Zeltoble, while Father set out hunting with his three slaves in tow, I say.
“Naofumi-sama, do take care!”
“Yuki-chan sees you off so cheerfully—makes me wonder about her clinging to Motoyasu-kun like this, doesn’t it?”
Yuki-chan clung to my back, cheerfully seeing Father off, I say.
“Well, Kou’s off too, then—”
“I’ll come pick you up later, indeed.”
“Yep. See ya—oh, and you should bring Kuro along next time too, I think—”

Kuro-chan as well, is it? Now that I think of it, Kuro-chan does seem fond of Ren, but has also grown close with Keel, indeed. Since I’m also planning to secure Luna-chan, it might be nice to let Kuro-chan pal around with her too.
“Motoyasu-sama, Yuki wants some stories to bring back for everyone.”
“Understood, indeed.”
Since Yuki-chan said she wanted to go out as well, I took her along to the Filolial racing grounds in Zeltoble.
